role_glow.clock: phase = floor(sharedElapsedMs / 250) % 2; use a shared clock for every segment, size and layer; never restart on target update
role_glow.registration: top-left target point (px,py): image at (px-target.x,py-target.y); nearest-neighbor; scale 1
role_glow.colors: cyan; size 6 adds pale-gold decoration outside top/bottom only
role_glow.legacy_spark: role_glow_6_spark preserved byte-for-byte; NOT part of continuous role glow animations
role_glow.segments: partition adopted position indices into maximal adjacent runs; select role_glow_<run length>; [0,1,3,4] -> two length-2 runs

piece_design.black_red_roles: suit-symbol category only; body color is not role color

mode2_countdown_sequence.game_step_ms: supplied by game logic; this asset set does not decide the rule
